Select exact IC50 activity values for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, docs, activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Filter by target CHEMBL3717, standard_type IC50, and presence of both canonical_smiles and (pubmed_id or doi). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows; do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
